svg.text: An SSRF bug can relay a GET to the metadata service; IMDSv2 answers only requests carrying a session token obtained with a PUT, which a relayed GET cannot get.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How a legitimate client gets in

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: PUT /latest/api/token with a TTL header returns a token; every GET then sends X-aws-ec2-metadata-token.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hop limit 1 means the PUT response cannot leave the instance; containers on the host need 2.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set the account default once: aws ec2 modify-instance-metadata-defaults --http-tokens required.

svg.text: IMDS answers on 169.254.169.254; tokens last up to 6 hours. Controls supported: CM-6, AC-3, SC-12, SC-28, SA-9(5); CIS AWS Foundations 5.6 (IMDSv2).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not AWS artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
